CONTESTED FACT (Expert round 2): the small-business exemption threshold is disputed -- Kol Zchut (Judge-verified live) says 120,000 NIS, Nagishut Israel/iAccessibility say 100,000 NIS. Resolved by HEDGING in all 3 files ('sources differ: 100,000 or 120,000; confirm against the regulation') rather than flat-asserting either, mirroring the skill's WCAG-version hedge. Added negishut-hamivne scoping line and user-side complaint path (Step 3).

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): operationalize native mobile-app accessibility (iOS UIAccessibility / Android APIs) since apps are in-scope but only static HTML is covered; add feedback-mechanism as an explicit element in the inline Step 9 statement template (currently only in the reference's 7-point list); collapse the WCAG-2.0 'sources differ' hedge from ~9 repetitions to one authoritative statement so it stops diluting the load-bearing warnings; note that the bundled audit_a11y.py is static-only and won't audit React/SPA contrast (soften the 'primary audit path' framing in Step 10).

CONTESTED FACT RESOLVED: the small-business exemption threshold is 120,000 NIS. Kol Zchut (refreshed 26.08.2026) enumerates the full tier ladder verbatim, so the 100,000 NIS alternative and the 'sources differ' hedge were dropped from SKILL.md, SKILL_HE.md and references/is-5568.md. A hedge that survives two cycles is a research debt, not calibration.

CORRECTNESS: the rakaz negishut duty was misattributed to the 2013 Service Accessibility Regulations and given a fabricated either/or trigger (public body OR 25+ employees). It is s.19מב of the primary Act (Amendment 2, 2005) with a SINGLE trigger: responsible for supplying a public service under Sign ד' AND employing at least 25 employees. Added the omitted ייעוץ והדרכה duty in 19מב(ב)(2).

CORRECTNESS: the 50,000 NIS statutory-damages figure was presented as flat and current in five places. It is the base in s.19נא(ב), index-linked annually against the CPI under 19נא(ו)(1) with base index February 2005. Reframed as base-plus-indexation everywhere; the updated 2026 sum was NOT located and is deliberately NOT computed.

GAP: enumerated the FULL עיצום כספי table from s.26ז(ג) as updated by הודעה תשפ"ו-2026 (4 Eighth Schedule parts x 3 debtor sizes, 12 amounts) plus the 27,360 NIS adequate-representation sum in 26ז(ב), and the s.26ז(א) size-band definitions by turnover in the year preceding the breach. Partial rate tables are a recurring defect in this catalog, so the whole grid goes in or none of it.

GAP: added the Chapter ט' in-force date (10.8.2023, conditioned on regulations under 26יב(ב)), Amendment 25/2024, and the re-indexing notices. The date bounds which conduct is exposed to the administrative track.

GAP: added the operator-side defenses in s.19נא(ג)(1א)-(1ב) and s.19נג(ג). The skill had presented the two enforcement tracks as purely parallel; they are not cumulative where a written undertaking is in force or an administrative penalty already landed on the same act.

SCRIPT: fixed 5 defects in scripts/audit_a11y.py. check_form_labels now recognises implicit label nesting, type='image' alt, and duplicate ids (it was FAILing every implicitly-labelled input). check_heading_hierarchy no longer fails a page for multiple H1s (valid HTML5 sectioning) and instead detects skipped levels, which is the real finding. check_page_title uses get_text() instead of .string (None whenever <title> has more than one child). check_accessibility_statement rejects in-page anchors, javascript: handlers and self-links, and is now documented as a weak signal, consistent with the skill's own overlay warning. main() exits 1 when any check fails, so the script can be a CI gate.

SCRIPT FIXTURE EVIDENCE: on a fixture with an implicit-label form, two H1s and a <title> containing a comment, the old code emitted FAIL form_labels (2 inputs), FAIL multiple H1, FAIL no <title>; the new code scores 8/8 and exits 0. On a fixture with h2 -> h4 the old code PASSED 'Heading hierarchy OK'; the new code FAILs with 'h2 -> h4' and exits 1.

UNVERIFIED, carried: whether the current ת"י 5568 חלק 1 edition reaches WCAG 2.1 AA (would need the SII paid standard). The existing WCAG 2.0 AA hedge survives this pass and was kept, only compressed from ~9 repetitions.

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): native mobile-app accessibility (iOS UIAccessibility / Android APIs) is still unoperationalized though apps are in scope; add the feedback mechanism as an explicit element of the inline Step 9 statement template; audit_a11y.py decodes with requests' latin-1 fallback when a server omits charset, so pass response.content to BeautifulSoup.

LEGAL GATE (legal-review, Tier B NOTICE_REQUIRED): the skill carries statutory-liability content a reader applies to their own turnover and conduct, but had no legal notice on any surface. Added '## Legal notice' / '## הבהרה משפטית' immediately after the H1 in both files, derived from the nine-component structure (first accessibility template in the catalog): no morshe negishut in the loop; not a morshe negishut opinion, not an accredited audit, not legal advice; the professional steps not performed (manual assistive-technology testing, IS 5568 Part 2 document review, the Regulation 35 technological-difficulty opinion, verification of the current index-linked damages figure); the Step 9 הצהרת נגישות block and audit_a11y.py output characterised as an internal working draft to be reviewed by a morshe negishut before publication or reliance; component 9 verbatim. Prepended the profession-specific opening clause to both descriptions. metadata.json display_description EN exceeded 1023 raw after prepending, so the 'teken negishot'/'nachim' transliteration clause was trimmed from the MIDDLE, leaving the opening legal clause and the 'Do NOT use for' tail intact.
